source: Meta Model API, video mode: one input_video request per clip and prompt (file upload, long side 1280 px, all frames), mask_encoding=one_bit, include_confidence=true; masks dropped
frame_index: 1 fps frame NNN (second s = NNN - 1) = video frame ceil((s + 0.5) * fps) - 1
box_units: pixels of frames/<clip>/NNN.jpg, [x1, y1, x2, y2], x2/y2 exclusive
track_id: SAM 3.1 object id, stable across the clip for one prompt (ids of different prompts are unrelated); a new id that starts within 1 s after an old one stopped, on an overlapping box (IoU >= 0.4) or within 0.3 m on the floor, takes the old id (detect/tracks.py); sam_track_id = the SAM id then
